top_products.hot_take: Glyphi is a game-changer for devouring written content, but its limitations will leave you wanting more.
top_products.deep_review: Glyphi: Speed Reader is an innovative tool that utilizes Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) to help users read faster and more efficiently. After spending an afternoon with it, I found the experience to be both fascinating and frustrating. The app works by flashing individual words on the screen at a pace you set, allowing your brain to process the information without moving your eyes. The standout moment came when I was able to breeze through a lengthy article in record time, feeling like I was absorbing the information with ease. However, the lack of support for certain file formats and the occasional misinterpretation of punctuation left me annoyed. Overall, Glyphi feels like a promising start, but it needs refinement to reach its full potential.

However, those who prefer a traditional reading experience or require extensive formatting options should look elsewhere.
